title: Synthetic Data Generation for HR Dataset
summary: A project that generates synthetic HR records with business-rule constraints and controlled distribution shifts, built for testing and analysis of hiring data. It runs SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer with a Metadata schema, custom constraints, conditional sampling, and evaluate_quality/run_diagnostic checks to produce and validate the synthetic dataset.
